seo_description: Instagram: @emceebrianlee · facebook.com/EmceeBrianLee · 94513443 · leesinshingbrian@gmail.com · “We had decided on Brian as our Emcee for our wedding based on a friend's recommendation. During the planning process, Brian was really meticulous and provided us great tips and advice from guided timelines to possible scenarios to anticipate/avoid and game ideas. It was very assuring to know that he was bilingual(including dialects), experienced and would be able to handle different impromptu situations. He also took time to get to know us, making his script personalized to our story. On the actual day, Brian was punctual and able to warm up the guests quickly. His charisma and energy kept the audience engaged and entertained throughout the lunch without making them feel uncomfortable. Due to the extra time needed for my hairdo for the 2nd March-in, there was a slight delay in the schedule. Brian demonstrated the ability to think on his feet and made the necessary adjustments accordingly. He was also able to transit between the 2 different languages with the right amount of humor adding a delightful touch to the banquet. Brian's professionalism and poise are truly commendable and I would definitely recommend him to others with any hesitation. Thank you Brian!”

name: Cang-Ai Wedding
seo_description: Instagram: @sg.cangai.wedding · facebook.com/cangaiwedsg · +65 6220 8520 · “We chose Cangai for our PWS & AD services, but the experience disappointed us. MUA Regina ruined my AD mood. She complained about the hotel chair, saying the backrest was too high and would hinder the hairstyling process. She demanded my sis to get a different one from the hotel. As the hotel couldn’t provide Regina with the chair she wanted, I had to ask my husband to bring one from his house although it was very rushed in the morning for both of us. Another MUA who handled my sis’s hairstyle didn’t have any issue with the same hotel chair though my sis’s hair was longer and we are the same height. Unlike other MUAs, Regina doesn’t have makeup mirror in her suitcase. With the long gown I was wearing, she made me move to the mirror near the toilet for hairstyling. Later, Regina used a mirror from the makeup palette to show me how I look with the different hair accessories. I could hardly see with that small mirror & she kept holding it at an angle not in my view. As I couldn’t see and time was limited, I blindly chose one of the hair accessories. Moreover, Regina left without putting on my veil, causing panic. I had to call her back & my bridesmaid even ran down to find her. Regina needs to improve in her professionalism. She told me that the suitcase is heavy, but this isn’t a valid reason for a MUA to not have a light-weighted mirror. I could have brought my own mirror if she’d told me that she doesn’t have one. Regina kept commenting on my hair and eyes, saying that they were very dry. These remarks were unnecessary and it dampened my mood. She was rough with my hair & pulled with the tool, telling me not to move my head toward the direction she was pulling. I naturally moved because I felt the pain. Despite being rushed, Regina still took her time to take videos of me for HER OWN USAGE. She asked me to strike different poses. I repeatedly told her I was late but she continued filming. This is terribly unacceptable. I was so stressed because of her. During Whatsapp coordination, Regina’s odd-hour calls and hard selling were off-putting. She wanted to do makeup for my family too. I worried about the rush since she’s the only one doing the makeup if we engage her service. She told me not to worry as she would plan an earlier time for them. Luckily, I didn’t agree as she struggled to finish my makeup and hairstyling on time. She didn’t do the hairstyle I wanted even though she was the one who did the hairstyle in the photo I showed her. She didn’t confirm about an ampoule during my 2nd makeup & broke one ($30) before I noticed. She suggested unnecessary expenses like a 2nd pair of fake eyelashes ($20) on top of my 1st pair of fake eyelashes. Regina’s poor service marred my once-in-a-lifetime wedding experience. I hope Cangai addresses this. Photographer Jeff was good, capturing highlights well. The photos received were beautiful. The coordinator, Xiaoting, was friendly but often unavailable. Gown and suit selection by two other ladies had mixed experience, with one being helpful and another impatient. The impatient lady did not allow me to go down to level 1 for new arrivals viewing even if requested. Cangai’s choices were limited compared to other studios. For PWS: We didn’t realized our shoot was booked on a Taiwan public holiday. Cangai was not proactive in informing us. Due to the crowd, we only managed to take a few shots at the same spot with the gown which I liked most. If we’re informed on this, we’d have chosen a different day. Also, we missed out on our main photoshoot location due to closure of the venue. We only knew upon arrival and the person in-charge told us that we should’ve known about it since they’d put out a notice. I think Cangai should’ve confirmed the venue availability before giving us the date. I felt helpless & our PWS album lacks variety. The sample photos advertised were outdated & didn’t match reality. Also, the sleeve of the suit in Taipei was too short and there were only 2 suits that could fit my husband. It was ridiculous & Cangai’s services left us disappointed.”

seo_description: +65 6835 7533 · “Received a pendant with chain from this shop from my husband as a gift. Chain broke after a few days. He went to the shop to get it repaired/replaced with new chain. name: Amanda Cheong Makeup Artist
seo_description: Instagram: @amandacheong_makeupartist · facebook.com/amandacheongmakeupartist · +65 9879 9329 · cheonglaithing510@gmail.com · “Amanda’s beginner makeup and hairstyling course was one of my best decisions in 2020! Lessons take place in her studio at Ubi, which is brightly lit and cozy (and always well stocked with drinks and snacks 😂). Amanda herself was very patient when i was enquiring about the course and asked many questions; she answered them all in full and very quickly. This gave me confidence that i would be in good hands. Classes were always rigorous and demanding, but with good reason. Amanda explained and demonstrated techniques with great attention to detail, and it was these details that would make a big difference in the quality of the end product. Amanda really teaches from the heart and she genuinely wants her students to learn and master all that she has learned from her 17 years of makeup and hair experience. When we don’t understand, she will explain and demo over and over again. During class she even shows us common mistakes and teaches us how to fix them. In terms of putting together your makeup and hair tools kit, Amanda gave us detailed explanations of each product type and their functions. She has a plethora of tried and tested recommendations so that you dont waste money buying the wrong things. She has an amazing teaching assistant Charlotte, who guides us patiently on fixing any mistakes. In a class of 5-6 students, having 2 teachers was great as we all got the guidance and attention we needed. Both Amanda and Charlotte gave us their time above and beyond the slated time slots of the course. When we took long to finish our practical classwork, sometimes dragging close to midnight (when class is supposed to end at 10pm), both teachers did not compromise on the quality of our work nor rushed us to finish quickly or skip steps so that they could get home sooner. They continued to guide us patiently, even if we had to redo and redo some things, until we learned the right techniques. I believe all the students in the class appreciated this tremendously. While Amanda’s studio and class provides us with a friendly and welcoming environment to start learning, she pushes us to get out into the real world by practicing on many different types of faces, skintones, skin types, hair types and hair colours, so that we will learn to deal with many situations and crises that might occur in real life and be well prepared to handle them. This course prepares you very well for the real world and while it was extremely tiring, I am grateful for this. Amanda requires high commitments of time and effort from her students to complete the course, but she puts in an equal amount of time and effort into teaching us and grading our extra assignments and practices. She would always reply with feedback when we sent her pictures of our work. Even after the course ends, Amanda and her team offer on-the-job training experiences when they work on real brides and bridal parties. As a student, I personally felt i gained so much more out of this course than the syllabus describes. In summary, this beginner makeup and hair course was challenging but also incredibly rewarding. I feel really lucky to have stumbled upon Amanda’s course and would do this over again in a heartbeat. Thank you from the bottom of my heart to Amanda and Charlotte for building and executing this amazing course. I recommend both teachers 200% for anyone who is looking to become a makeup artist!!”

name: TiffiningBeauty Makeup and Hair
seo_description: Instagram: @tiffiningbeauty · facebook.com/TiffiningBeauty · +65 9665 9990 · hello@tiffiningbeauty.com · “in short, I didn’t have a good experience with her and I wouldn’t recommend her. Wish I joined this chat before I paying the deposit. My tips before paying the deposit: - ask when you can have your trial. I had to take leave just for the trial becuz Tiffany’s trial period is only during the weekdays at certain timing. Also, she went on a long 3 month break because she got pregnant but I only found out about this through coming across her Instagram post. I thought it was really unprofessional of her not to tell me this personally because I already paid the deposit and it affected when I could have my trial make up. - ask whether she will stay with you throughout your wedding or at least be there in between your looks to help with touching up the make up. The short context was that Tiffany left for another appointment on my wedding day after doing my hair and make up for the first look. She didn’t stay to wait until I changed into my bridal gown after the tea ceremony. My sister had to loan me her lip gloss, touch up my make up, help me into my bridal dress and put on my veil for me. Most MUA will usually help you with all these but please don’t assume. - ask how long it takes for her to do the hair/makeup. The first look will take about 2 hours. The style change will need about 40mins for Tiffany. - ask whether there will be any surcharge if the waiting time in between your 1st look and 2nd look is a few hours. I had an interval of ~6 hours between my first look and second look and there wasn’t a surcharge for mine but I thought it’s a good question to ask. There was a surcharge for starting my make up at 6am though. She was late on my wedding day and I started ~30mins after my scheduled timing for make up. The make up was still pretty okay after 6 hours but then again, my whole schedule was conducted within the hotel so I was in an aircon environment throughout. Tiffany tried to convince me to have a shorter duration of waiting time between my 2 looks but I’m glad I stuck with my schedule. - make sure your MUA knows your schedule and arrives early for your 2nd look. You never know how your schedule will actually play out on the actual day. My 2nd look was scheduled to be at 2pm and she said that she will be back at exactly 2pm. But obviously your MUA cannot arrive at exactly 2pm because what if your schedule goes faster than expected? My sister therefore asked her to come at 1pm. My schedule overran a little and by the time I met her, it was around 2.15pm. She complained that she waited very long for me and basically had a little bit of a black face and it was as if she was blaming my sister for asking her to come early. - ask if your MUA provides hair accessories , Tiffany does provide some hair accessories to choose from without any additional cost Other comments on this: - she doesn’t rlly pay attention to the details IMO. I had to ask her to put more concealer over certain dark spots or tell her that the false eyelash wasn’t flushed against my lids and needed more glue. She sprayed this false hair shadow thing at my hairline and didn’t blend it out. It was only when my mum said that it looked like 2 50cent coin circle marks that she tried to blend it out. - the hair and make up for both looks turned out okay, people complimented my make up and hair but honestly, a lot of other make up artist could also produce the same looks. In fact, if I had known earlier that my bridal shop also offer make up services, I would have went for that because my 2 hairstyles wasn’t complicated (low bun and big wavy curls) and the bridal make up look is kinda the same for most MUA more or less.”

name: Jeffery Koh Photography
seo_description: Instagram: @jeffery.koh · facebook.com/jefferykohphotography · +65 9438 5476 · “We booked a pre-wedding photo and video shoot with Aloysius in June 2022, and also engaged Aloysius and Jeffery for Actual Day videography and photography respectively in March 2023. Looking for experienced, quality and communicative vendors was our priority, and partnering with Aloysius (@ourweddingstory) and Jeffery (@jeffery.koh) was one of the best decisions we made in our wedding planning. Aloysius and Jeffery's experience was evident from how they communicated and directed the shoot in the different stages - from planning, execution and into delivery. At the planning stage, they were always happy and patient to share their thoughts with us and pretty responsive to our queries over both email and WhatsApp. When we met them for the shoots, they prioritised our preferences such as location, music choice and even asking which our preferred face profiles were! They made the shoots enjoyable with their sense of humour and clear direction, and gave us enough time to warm up and to be comfortable. With our families, they were patient and friendly, and were able to capture the important moments with our families' raw emotions. Family and friends were amazed at how Aloysius and Jeffery were able to blend in with the day's programs and crowds and made everyone feel comfortable on camera. When we finally saw the end products, we knew we made the right choice engaging both Aloysius and Jeffery. The photos were well composed with great colours, and our expressions were natural and happy :) Aloysius' videos captured our stories in a clear storyline, with our preferred song choice perfectly incorporated and edited to fit the video. Our guests were impressed by the cinematic quality of both the pre-wed and same day edit videos that were played during the wedding lunch. It was also a novel experience for our guests, whom may not have been familiar with weddings being captured on video and so it was exciting for them to see themselves onscreen :) Overall, Aloysius and Jeffery's works are quality and anyone engaging them can feel rest assured that their concerns and preferences will be heard, and that their stories will be translated through their works. The photos and videos with our family and loved ones will remain a very cherished souvenir from the wedding, and we can't express enough thanks to Aloysius and Jeffery for that :)”

name: UnderTheStars Photography
seo_description: Instagram: @underthestarsphotography · facebook.com/underthestars.sg · +65 9834 5744 · “We’ve received our wedding pictures and they are just so beautiful and touching. We would just like to say a huge thank you to Lawrence for being our wedding photographer. The wedding pictures are simply spectacular. It makes us so happy looking through them because they allow us to relive an incredible weekend. Lawrence just felt like an old friend. When we first saw his works about 2 years ago, we loved how natural they were, how he had captured what really happened rather than posed shots or worse, faked moments! We also loved the creativity in his compositions. During our wedding weekend, he worked professionally, quickly and incredibly hard to beautifully capture everyone and every moment that he could. I don’t think he even flinched when the champagne cork flew in his direction! We received our pictures sooner than expected. It was great when we can share them with our guests while it was fresh in their memories. And I remembered seeing our pictures for the first time was quite overwhelming. It brought back so many emotions from the day – we laughed and cried all over again. I wasn’t sure how we would ever choose for our album. It’s very hard to put into words what we love about his photos… but we’ll try! We love that they are of real moments, capturing the quirks and details that make people and relationships unique. We love the raw emotion he captured, not just people smiling but pride, nerves, disbelief, triumph, love, joy and hope. We like the element of surprise in his photos from unusual angles and varied techniques. When we look through our pictures, they tell our story. Thank you again Lawrence. Our wedding was everything we hoped it would be, and you captured it so beautifully.”

name: Loveinstills
seo_description: Instagram: @loveinstills · facebook.com/loveinstills · +65 8797 6263 · “Experience and Passion /ɪkˈspɪərɪəns,ɛkˈspɪərɪəns & ˈpaʃn/ The two keywords you'll see us mention frequently summarise what Sebastian radiates for our pre-wedding photoshoot. Love in Stills was the fourth photographer we've talked to during the wedding show and the only one we felt comfortable with and able to relate to. He shared his passion and experience with other couples' shoots, and it gave me and my fiancee a comfortable feeling that we are able to sync and communicate easily. This is key; communication with your photographer allows your shoot to be enjoyable! We just completed our shoot a couple of days ago in Perth, and everything went better than we imagined. Myself and my fiancee rarely take pictures, and as such, we don't pose or stand very fluidly (stiff sticks, if you ask me). Sebastian, with his experience, took time to show us, pose us, and radiate his passion to us, so we laughed and enjoyed the shoot. We were tired as heck with sores and pains, but we enjoyed every bit of it! And also, here's what we'll like to share: 1. Do not worry about what to do; let Sebastian direct you. He's a genius. Tell him the location, and let him choose the angle! He will show you his experience and passion, explaining why he did what he did! 2. Enjoy the shoot! Laugh, smile, and annoy your partner. 3. Have about 2 hours allocated per location. 4. Food and drinks; we're humans after all. 5. Always have Plan B locations for unforseen weather. 6. Read the contract to see what's included and what's not. PS: Sebastian is a foodie too! Feed him!”

name: Heaven's Gift
seo_description: +65 6220 0378 · “Can I give 100 stars to begin with? Heavens Gift was truly the best damn decision we made to have them plan our wedding!! Honestly I didn’t have any idea or expectations from the start cos I don’t know how wedding planning is suppose to be. Boy, did Hannah and her team open up my world and gave me an experience that I can never forget. They say once you have a wedding, you don’t ever want to do such things again. I can guarantee you it’s not true if you have Hannah (haha), everyday I want to relive the moment again cos they have given my guest and us the most beautiful memory ever. The planning started with them getting to know us better from color choices, style and vibes (there’s more to it but I shall not spoil it for you!). We told them we wanted a wedding like it’s a big party. We wanted guest to roam around, engage in diff activities and just an experience that is diff from a general wedding. My most crucial criteria was I wanted to be able to decorate a lot in the venue. They bought us to a venue that we never knew about and it was perfect! It was an empty canvas with beautiful lights which I left it in Hannah’s good hands to come out a vision board for me. I just want to say, they exceeded way way wayyy beyond our expectations. From the entrance where she did a gallery to showcase our prewed photos and opened up to our mirror aisle, amazing stage and seating area. Their attention to details were insane!! From the placement of the chairs to be slightly slanted, the table settings and even down to the menu! She nailed it in all aspect from the decorations to the experiences my guest can enjoy and have. When I first walked in to the hall, I burst out with so much joy because it was a special moment for me and she transformed the place to such a vibe. Hannah knows that I love hot pink and she didn’t fail to add that touch in for me which made me so happy to see. She will make sure to add personal touches of what both me and my husband likes so it truly reflects us. Cos honestly, people came up to us and say, when they walked in, this vibe is so us. I think this is the thing you want to experience, a wedding party that reflects who you are. The whole process of this planning was honestly very little stress cos all I had to do was prepare myself to look the best I can. Heaven’s Gift did all the searching and suggestions for us whenever I have a request of what I wanted. From our food vendors, emcee, dj and my very difficult request for a pastry chef who can make me a millefoglie as our wedding cake. She managed to find someone who did it for me and did so well. Our wedding was more than perfect and I just want to keep reliving every moment of it again and again. So to anyone who wants to have a wedding where you don’t need to have decision fatigue, HG is the perfect choice. The only regret you will have is that you don’t engage Heaven’s Gift to be your planner. They are so meticulous with everything that you have no worries. Thank you Hannah and team once again for such an amazing experience. I truly look forward for another party I will have and having them on board again ❤️ Love, Iggy and Daphne”

seo_description: Instagram: @ribbonsandtwines · “Seen there advertisements on instagram and thought that their services were good. Enquired on the pricing and packages, which received quick response. I told Liz I felt it was too early for us to decide and she assured us that if we were to change our minds within 90 days, she would refund us the deposit. Initially, she replied very promptly, however, after we decided to not proceed with her services, her response was delayed. I had to constantly chase her through WhatsApp. Liz finally replied after one week, informing me that her entire team was down with covid that's why they were unable to reply to my messages. I was very understanding, giving her time to provide me with the addendum. From 28 May - 08 June, I had to constantly text her regarding the email of the addendum. Our addendum stated that my refund will be processed on 10 June. However, as she did not ask me to sign the addendum until 08 June, I was understanding enough to note that it would be processed three weeks from the date that the letter was signed. After three weeks, still no refund. My fiancee and I had to constantly send emails and text messages to get an update on the progress of the refund but with no response. But, finally, they did provide us with a refund. I'm glad we did not proceed with their services given their attitude after we decided not to sign with them. It would have been a nightmare if they decided not to be responsive on our big day. I definitely would not recommend.”

name: M&B Private Jewelers
seo_description: +65 8228 6018 · “Before working with M&B to create my engagement ring and our wedding bands, my partner and I went to several other private and big-name jewelers, but none of them were as professional, knowledgeable, and proactive as Sharon and Mori. From the first time we walked in, we were treated with the utmost respect. We had a lot of questions, and all of them were answered, no matter how small or insignificant. To be frank, we didn't have very good experiences elsewhere—sales associates were often quite snobby—so M&B stood out because of their impeccable service from day one. I knew from the get-go that I didn't want a conventional round diamond—I was torn between an emerald or a pear cut. However, I couldn't actually visualize what would look better on my hand before going to M&B, as most other jewelers did not have stones within my desired carat range. M&B is home to Singapore's largest collection of fancy-cut natural diamonds, so I was able to try on and look at every single shape I could think of, from 3 carats all the way to a staggering 10. We redo the setting not once, twice but 3 times still the issue can’t be resolved. (The diamond was a 0.70 carat F SI2 cut and polish is excellent while the symmetry is very good, GIA cert since April 2019 that cost $3600 together with ring setting it is $4380 in total). The ring is a basic 4 claws classic slightly twisted 14K white gold. There was symmetry issue with the claws, which one side is slight higher than another. It can be clearly seen with our eyes, but they can’t see it, they said it’s perfect for them. If you as a jeweller has issue about jewelry symmetry, a huge question mark on your professionalism. They said ring setting was done by subcontractors, then I would suggest you to change your partner, or ask them to improve their craftsmanship, but not expect your customer to accept that hand craft is “IMPERFECT”. I doubt that. (Do note that previously the ring band is not round as well after resizing, that have been resolved but not the symmetry issue) The male boss admitted the issue and promise to redo the setting, will “sit besides the craft man” and make sure everything is perfect for us. My concern is about the lady name Vri and another is a caucasian lady. (Pardon us for naming her in such a way as we don’t have her name we only remember the 1st person that serve us which is Gladys however she don’t seem to be there after resizing the ring) After the second adjustment on ring setting and resize, Vri did not agree the setting was off and insisted that if we asked for redo there’s nothing much can be further done. I couldn’t accept then she only called boss in to deal with us. Red flag. After the last adjustment, as we can still see the setting was odd, raising our concern, the Caucasian lady came to us and say “WHAT’S the issue now, can you explain? I believe this is the best we can do, I saw it perfectly. If you are unhappy, we can refund for you” yes this was her original line. Her tone of voice is very condescending. Instead of offering their apologies first that was their “direct reply” given to us. She said it’s her culture to speak directly and did apologise after that. Sorry I see no culture should be this rude, she can’t even let us finish our lines when we were trying to explain to them what their eyes CANNOT SEE. Using the excuse “from where I coming from is to speak directly” is clearly not acceptable in the service line. The issue we take here is their attitude and how they handle their customer in a situation that is caused by their shortfall. We truly believe one can be more tactful with theirs choice of words and attitude. They have over promise and under delivered. (something which the male boss have promise that he would ensure it would be perfect this time round) If they couldn't do they should not have promise it and wasted each other time. If they were to put themselves in the customer perspective when your wedding is up soon and your ring is not even ready how would you feel. PS: We have read your response and accepted your apologies, we wish your business all the best. We have edited Vri's name as well and offer our apologies on that as we miss her name out. PPS: There is no personal privacy of mine being protected when you have decided to use my full name 👍”

name: storïs Fine Jewellery
seo_description: +65 9685 8136 · “storïs | Evelyn The reviews so far talk about her product but why you should [cross that out, must] go see her is the experience. Allow me to share. Let's start w/ mindset: Proposing isn’t easy, it's a decision for life, everything will change, there's so much to think about, & you want to make the moment perfect. O yeah, and you have to get the ring right. It's daunting. How do you balance romance w/ practicality? Tradition says we [the men] select a ring that will fit & represent our beautiful bride to be without her knowing? Talk about pressure. In modern times so many elect to take a practical approach. It's safer, I totally get it. But, Guys, go see Evelyn 1st. Before you make a decision, just talk to her. My experience, what sold me: Her process is so unique and helps draw out what's important, things you might not have thought about. Being from the US, and having never heard of storïs, I stupidly tried to just show up thinking it was like any other jeweler, just a showroom. I found it's appointment only. My Girlfriend apparently loves her designs so I reached out and made an appointment, still thinking I’d be going in and looking at pre-made rings. I’d done my research, took pictures of all her jewelry, for months had my sisters & her friends help discretely pull info out of her about what she preferred based on what she'd seen before. So when I went in for the appointment I was basically prepared to just find something that fit. Evelyn sat me down in front of her counter covered w/ samples, but instead of showing me any of these, she began by asking me about how we met. It was a conversation about us, our relationship, who WE are. This conversation went on and I found myself almost over sharing, laughing w/ Evelyn who all the while was drawing and making some notes. We talked about our first meeting, what caused us to fall in love, how and what kept that going, what it was that made me decide to propose, how I was planning to propose. It was such a natural convo. To my surprise as an introvert I was not only sharing but felt comfortable doing so. After a while Evelyn paused and said so this is what I'm thinking. She had literally been designing from scratch in front of me and had through the conversation pulled out things that were fundamental to our relationship to represent in the engagement ring. This was not just a ring, but a story of us. I was shocked, it was perfect. Previously I worried about balancing my GF’s unique style w/ our differences and how those all collide. In front of me was a ring that I knew she would cherish and would fit the moment perfectly. I didn't walk out w/ a ring, instead I pushed back my plans for a month, and I was happy to do so. Side note: I was so in awe I totally forgot to ask about pricing, she could have listed an outrageous number. It was that good. But that's not Evelyn. She has a heart for people, and this is not just her business or a job, this is her calling, one that she's so uniquely suited for. She broke it down, educated me on the gems, materials, and the cost was so reasonable I was stunned. Honestly I would have paid more going to a normal jeweler. After the proposal my now Fiancé asked how I found such a unique & beautiful ring. I told her it was storïs, the jeweler she’d followed for years [before we even meet]. Why I'm writing this now: Fast forward, we went back to Evelyn for our wedding bands, which are honestly better as she blended all 3 rings into a beautiful story that fit US personally. Recently when my now Wife's ring lost a gem on a trip we went back. We have referred multiple people to go experience her magic, and can’t say enough about her. I have to admit, we’ve stayed in contact for 2+ years now because she's just a genuine good human that has impacted our lives in so many positive ways. So I'm not just recommending storïs, I'm telling you that you're not going to regret meeting this amazing person & will walk away w/ a similar story. I believe this so much so you can message me to ask for more details if you're not convinced.”

name: Artemis Rings
seo_description: +65 9616 4588 · “It’s been a long enough time that I feel comfortable posting this. Just to preface this review: we had a really terrible experience here some time back but i am always weary about posting publicly because I have witnessed and heard from many others that I know, that local single business owners can’t take negative feedback and become extremely defensive and can even be vindictive especially if they can identify who you are and have your personal contact details. Therefore I usually don’t post my negative experiences but there are certain instances I do feel should be shared and this is one of them. I do not wish for a response, just to give my honest experience. Now to the review: We decided to contact Artemis rings as we had read an article about the previous jewellery business she had with her former partner and liked the designs. We were interested to create wedding rings and potentially an engagement ring. Firstly, the communication to set an appointment was a bit strange as she kept asking if another person who had made a different appointment was us. She asked on the phone a two times and again asked the same thing when we visited physically. Not sure why given the mobile number and time slot we agreed on was not the same. Secondly, when we had our appointment she kept talking about her various Tai Tai clients and how she only takes certain jobs - and how other jewellers she knows of her quality are the same. She kept trying to fish for our careers and kept talking about other clients careers (surgeons or business owners or what not), it felt really uncomfortable like we were being passive aggressively profiled to determine our wealth status. Not that it matters as we weren’t even at the stage of discussing pricing or anything. Then finally somewhere in her discussion, she said she needed us to buy a stone from her for the engagement ring in order to make a profit. Which then put us off from anything further. When we asked if we could just then make the wedding bands we initially asked the appointment for, she ignored that and continued to make remarks that she didn’t know another jeweller who could do what we were looking for in terms of design that we wouldn’t have to beg to, which was completely not humble and sounded arrogant (this is simply untrue because there are thousands of jewellers in Singapore and the very next one we randomly asked did everything we wanted swiftly and to an extremely high standard.) I believe this line of discussion came about because we had enquired about creating an engagement ring with other gems (family diamonds / others) as we have some knowledge on this and traditional jewellers do not always have the ability to get what we need. By the way, we were not constrained by any budget but since the discussion devolved down this path we let it naturally end as we already had bad feelings about the whole vibe. Overall it felt like she was trying to be a gatekeeper of the ring industry and portray that she is in such high demand that some people are not worthy of paying her to create rings. With times evolving, the jewellery industry becoming more service-oriented and the thousands of other jewellers in Singapore and beyond, this is just an experience to avoid.”

She asked on the phone a two times and again asked the same thing when we visited physically. Not sure why given the mobile number and time slot we agreed on was not the same. Secondly, when we had our appointment she kept talking about her various Tai Tai clients and how she only takes certain jobs - and how other jewellers she knows of her quality are the same. She kept trying to fish for our careers and kept talking about other clients careers (surgeons or business owners or what not), it felt really uncomfortable like we were being passive aggressively profiled to determine our wealth status. Not that it matters as we weren’t even at the stage of discussing pricing or anything. Then finally somewhere in her discussion, she said she needed us to buy a stone from her for the engagement ring in order to make a profit. Which then put us off from anything further. When we asked if we could just then make the wedding bands we initially asked the appointment for, she ignored that and continued to make remarks that she didn’t know another jeweller who could do what we were looking for in terms of design that we wouldn’t have to beg to, which was completely not humble and sounded arrogant (this is simply untrue because there are thousands of jewellers in Singapore and the very next one we randomly asked did everything we wanted swiftly and to an extremely high standard.) I believe this line of discussion came about because we had enquired about creating an engagement ring with other gems (family diamonds / others) as we have some knowledge on this and traditional jewellers do not always have the ability to get what we need. By the way, we were not constrained by any budget but since the discussion devolved down this path we let it naturally end as we already had bad feelings about the whole vibe. Overall it felt like she was trying to be a gatekeeper of the ring industry and portray that she is in such high demand that some people are not worthy of paying her to create rings. With times evolving, the jewellery industry becoming more service-oriented and the thousands of other jewellers in Singapore and beyond, this is just an experience to avoid.”
